messages:
elaine: Heads-up — NovaBank procurement looped us asking for SOC2 + ISO excerpts and a signed pen-test attestation for the POC. They also want to understand how Dedicated vs Hosted affects seat/pricing. Deadline: EOD Friday. Who can pull the artifacts and a short pricing note?
matt: I can assemble the proofpack. Do they need full network diagrams (on‑prem) or just ISO scope + control matrix excerpt?
devin: We can provide SOC2 summary, control mappings, ISO27001 scope excerpt, and a pen-test attestation letter (template + signatory needed). Prefer a secure dataroom or presigned bundle — which does procurement prefer? @ops-bot can generate presigned if needed.
elaine: Procurement asked for a bundled ZIP in the Dataroom ideally. They said presigned S3 links are also OK if they expire after download. Confirming timeline: 3pm UTC Friday. Also, they want a headline cost delta for Dedicated seats vs hosted for POC scale.
sarah: For a quick ballpark: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) for small POC usage ~ $5k–$8k/month depending on token volumes. Dedicated reserved baseline for similar steady load ~ $15k–$22k/month + seat/support uplift. I'll need expected throughput to tighten.
matt: POC expected traffic: peak ~3k requests/min in stress test, realistic POC traffic ~200 requests/min, ~200 concurrent sessions for the demo. Use the lower band for the POC quote.
sarah: Great — will draft a short note with ranges and two options (Hosted POC, Dedicated monthly commit) and send a quote PDF.
devin: Action items for artifacts: I can pull SOC2 summary, control matrix snippets (data access, encryption, incident mgmt), and draft the pen-test attestation. I need someone to provide network diagram and any VPC endpoints they care about.
matt: I’ll upload a minimal network diagram + sample infra notes. Also will include the requested sample logs we typically share for procurement (anonymized).
ops-bot: presign link created: https://dropbox.com/s/placeholder-novabank-proofpack?dl=0 — expires in 7 days. (this is a placeholder; final link to be posted when upload completes)
elaine: @linda (legal) — can we get a signatory on the pen-test attestation? They may require legal sign-off if the letter references indemnity or liability items.
linda: I can review and sign, but legal needs security to confirm wording first. Devin, please share the attestation draft and call out any non-standard commitments.
devin: Will post draft in the same dataroom tonight and tag @linda. Draft will include: scope of test, date, findings statement (no live vulnerabilities disclosed), and signatory line for our security lead.
matt: Uploading artifacts to dataroom now, will ping when done.
elaine: Awesome — once uploaded, I'll send to procurement with the pricing note. If we can get the signed pen-test letter by Friday that keeps the procurement cycle on track. :thumbsup:
devin: Working on it — aim to have draft by tomorrow morning for legal review.
linda: Thanks, loop me in when draft is up and I’ll prioritize review.
elaine: Thanks everyone — will update NovaBank after upload.
